query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    'Location Details'[Geographic Region],
    'Products Details'[Products Category],
    TREATAS ( { 2020 }, 'Calender'[Year] ),
    "Sales", [Total Sales],
    "Profit", [Total Profit]
)
ORDER BY 'Location Details'[Geographic Region], 'Products Details'[Products Category]
